statement: Because Linux and SDL both use Wii-transport mechanics with a distinct embedded Pro gamepad topology rather than a hot-pluggable Remote accessory, a separate wii-u-pro curated family with reused Wii protocol transport/report helpers is the preferred design over a Wii Remote extension variant exposed to callers.

applicability.revision: Wii U Pro; retail revision not measured
applicability.scope: Architecture recommendation, not a physical equivalence claim or implementation decision.
